text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The grand finale to this year's dirt racing season, the Tokyo Daishoten! The excitement at the venue is even more intense than usual!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...This race is Inari's final stop of the year.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let us see it through.
...As one who runs in the same era as Inari-chan.

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text: ...To think I'd see both Oguri Cap and Super Creek here at the Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, their goal is Inari One...?
Does she mean that much to Oguri Cap and the others...?

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
After that Arima Kinen between Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap,
I'll need to keep a close eye on what kind of running
she'll show us next...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —The time has finally come, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, to the point where I kinda wish
someone could tell me how to stop these jitters.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —I'm gonna nail this big race, just watch me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Lady Inari is gonna take the "top spot" in the regional circuit—make sure you don't blink and miss it!
choice_data_list: I'll be there to watch until the very end!
I'll definitely see it through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yo.
Been a while since the Japan Dirt Derby, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oi Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "...Just as expected. If I let my guard down, that incredible pressure would knock me off my feet. That's 'Inari One' for ya."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...You're incredible too.
Ever since the Japan Dirt Derby, you've conditioned yourself into looking like a whole different runner."

text_block_list.name: Oi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"It ain't just me, either.
Everyone's been busting their tails to beat ya
and take the top spot."

text_block_list.name: Oi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see how we measure up today.
With our... true Ohi spirit!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
I'll make damn sure to show ya!
The run of Lady Inari taking the top!
